summary: Re-ran existing browser checks + backend suite against the theme/upload/billing acceptance matrix (7 criteria). 6/7 passed. Found 1 real frontend bug: theme does not follow the account across a fresh session (localStorage cleared) even though the backend correctly persists and returns it.

bugs.criterion: Theme follows the account across sessions
bugs.description: Setting theme=daylight persists correctly server-side (PATCH /api/me/theme -> 200, GET /api/auth/me -> theme:'daylight'), but after clearing localStorage and reloading, the app repaints as 'readout' (default) instead of reading the account's stored theme from /api/auth/me. The frontend theme-init logic only reads localStorage, not the account record, so a fresh browser/session loses the chosen theme.
bugs.evidence: Browser check 'theme-persists-via-account' failed twice (rerun-confirmed, not flaky): after page.evaluate(()=>localStorage.clear()) + reload, html[data-theme] stayed 'readout' (14x observed) instead of expected 'daylight'. Backend cross-check via curl: POST /api/auth/login -> 200; GET /api/auth/me -> theme:'readout' initially; PATCH /api/me/theme {theme:'daylight'} -> 200 body theme:'daylight'; GET /api/auth/me again -> theme:'daylight' (confirmed persisted server-side, so this is a frontend-only bug). Reset account back to 'readout' after the test to avoid polluting shared seed data.

checks.criterion: BUG FIX: primary buttons readable in all three themes (were white-on-yellow)
checks.name: primary-button-contrast-per-theme
checks.evidence: hero-cta-button on / checked across readout/blueprint/daylight: bg colors match rgb(226,249,82)/rgb(91,233,224)/rgb(22,80,155) respectively, text luminance dark for readout & blueprint, light for daylight -- never white-on-yellow. Screenshots captured per theme.

checks.criterion: Each theme loads its own fonts
checks.name: theme-font-families-differ
checks.evidence: heading/body/mono computed font-family matched Chakra Petch/Sora/JetBrains Mono (readout), Syne/Inter Tight/IBM Plex Mono (blueprint), Archivo/Instrument Sans/Space Mono (daylight); all three heading fonts pairwise distinct.

checks.criterion: Theme follows the account across sessions
checks.name: theme-persists-via-account
checks.evidence: PATCH /api/me/theme + GET /api/auth/me confirmed server-side theme='daylight' persisted, but after localStorage.clear() + reload, html[data-theme] remained 'readout' instead of 'daylight'. Failed identically on rerun (not flaky). See bugs[].

checks.name: theme-repaints-all-pages
checks.evidence: With theme=blueprint set, /dashboard, /upload, /costing, /billing and /jobs/seed-job-harborview all rendered body background rgb(6,10,22) (blueprint --t-base), correct testids visible on each, zero page errors collected.

checks.name: upload-page-estimate-shown
checks.evidence: upload-submit-button disabled with no file; after picking a 3-page PDF fixture, page-estimate visible, estimate-pages contains '3 page', estimate-cell-set/now/after visible, submit button text 'Read 3 page...' and enabled (fits within plan quota).

checks.name: billing-topup-purchase-completes
checks.evidence: /billing shows topup-topup25 ($29) and topup-topup60 ($59) panels; Buy pack opened checkout.stripe.com, filled test card 4242 4242 4242 4242, paid, redirected to /payment/success with 'confirmed' text, and /api/billing/usage afterwards showed page_credits increased by >=25 and pages_remaining incremented accordingly.

checks.criterion: Landing states metering honesty and why to upgrade
checks.name: landing-transparency-and-why-upgrade
checks.evidence: landing-transparency visible with page-related copy; landing-why-upgrade visible containing Crew/Contractor/Agency; why-upgrade-pricing-link points to #pricing and scrolls landing-pricing into view; why-upgrade-trial-link href matches /login?mode=signup.

checks.criterion: Wrong password / session behavior (regression coverage carried from prior iteration, kept green)
checks.name: test_tscheck_auth_session.py
checks.evidence: pytest -q against live server: 3 passed, 4 warnings in 0.91s (login sets cross-site cookie & authenticates, wrong password rejected 401, logout destroys session).
